name: Gujarat

dance: Garba (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage), Dandiya Raas, Bhavai

mcqs.q: Where is the Statue of Unity, the world's tallest statue (182 meters), located?
mcqs.exp: The Statue of Unity honoring Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel is situated on Sadhu Bet island facing the Sardar Sarovar Dam.

mcqs.q: Which UNESCO World Heritage site in Gujarat is a monumental stepwell built during the Chaulukya dynasty?
mcqs.exp: Rani ki Vav in Patan was built by Queen Udayamati in memory of King Bhima I and is featured on the ₹100 note.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Gujarat.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Gandhinagar. Gujarat covers a geographic area of 196,024 sq km across 33 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Narmada, Tapi, Sabarmati, Mahi.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Has the longest coastline of any Indian state (approx 1,600 km). Birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Sole global home of the wild Asiatic lion in Gir National Park.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Gujarat.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Gujarat was formally instituted on 1 May 1960. Official language(s): Gujarati.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Garba (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage), Dandiya Raas, Bhavai.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Navratri, Rann Utsav, Uttarayan (Kite Festival).

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Gujarat.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Acharya Devvrat.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Gujarat is Bhupendra Patel.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Gujarat High Court (Ahmedabad).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Asiatic lion | State Bird: Greater flamingo | State Flower: Marigold | State Tree: Banyan.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Gujarat.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Petroleum (Ankleshwar, Kalol), Natural Gas, Bauxite, Salt (largest producer in India).

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Gujarat plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Gujarat.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Statue of Unity (182m, world's tallest), Sun Temple Modhera, Rani ki Vav (Patan, UNESCO), Somnath Temple.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Gir National Park, Blackbuck National Park (Velavadar), Marine National Park (Gulf of Kutch), Vansda.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Gujarat.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana, Kisan Suryodaya Yojana, Namo Lakshmi Scheme.
